rules: A corpse without a projected loot owner is unrestricted.
An exclusive loot duration requires a non-empty loot owner.
Before exclusive expiration, only the projected loot owner may loot items or gold.
At or after expiration, item and gold loot are unrestricted unless another subsystem adds an independently proven restriction.
Denied loot attempts are atomic and cannot mutate corpse, item, or gold state.
Exact Classic ownership, party, killer, NPC, and sysop rules remain fail-closed and unassigned.

ownership.items: item and gold transfer authorization primitive
ownership.character_npc: death sequencing and eligible looter identity source
